x: In a recent article in the Sunday Express, the writer expressed confidence that Britain's young athletes will soon be amongst the world's best. Amongst those mentioned, we were favoured by the mention of seven members:—Broadbent, Clay, Frost, Brown, Marchant, Burfitt and Main.

We have the talent, some of it already shown, some of it dormant, but to mention only these few names is to comment on a strength which could do much: Broadbent, Botwright, Burfitt, Blowfield, Nankeville, Marchant, Herbert, Read, Lucas, Stimpson.
In the 100 yards, Broadbent won his heat in 10.7; qualified in the second round and was third in a 10.4 final.
Robertson. 100 yards: 1st, Broadbent; 4th, Grimshaw, 10.1. 220 yards: 2nd, Broadbent. 440 yards: 5th, Heathfield; 6th, A. Beaumont. 880 yards: 2nd, Burfitt; 4th, A.
100 yards: 1st, Broadbent; 2nd, Walden, 10.4 secs. 220 yards: 1st, Walden; 2nd, Grimshaw, 24.0 secs. 440 yards: 3rd, Grimshaw. 880 yards: 1st, A.
